Lisa Sthalekar, the India-born cricketer who was adopted out of a Pune orphanage and later became one of Australia’s leading international players, is the subject of a feature film in development at “Wedding Season” star Pallavi Sharda‘s Bodhini Studios.

The company has secured the rights to the life story of Sthalekar, now a cricket commentator, and Sharda describes it as the flagship feature on the studio’s slate.

“We’ve been really working hard to bring the right voices,” Sharda tells Variety. “What differentiates the way we’re working as a diaspora group of artists is making sure that our voices are in the room from inception. And it’s not something that happens as an afterthought.”

Sharda hasn’t been officially cast as Sthalekar, though she says the cricketer would like her to play the role. “And the other producers on board, who I can’t reveal right now, probably would,” she adds.

The film brings together cricket and storytelling, two of the most lasting ties between Australia and India, and centers on a female athlete’s story.

Sharda, a Screen Australia board member, is in Goa with the agency’s delegation to the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) and the WAVES Film Bazaar. The group hopes to forge alliances through the Australia–India Audiovisual Co-production Agreement, a 2023 pact that lets filmmakers in the two countries work together and draw on qualifying public funding and incentives.

“As a board member of Screen Australia, I have a huge interest in how we tell our stories and how we shape Australian stories for the world,” Sharda says. “So for me, the practical steps really come under my guise as a practitioner more than my board role.”

Sharda launched Bodhini in 2024, naming it after the feminine of the Bodhi tree. “The idea is to tell stories consciously and to deep dive into the communities that enabled me to be an artist, which was the Indian community of Australia,” she says. The company has already run several writers’ rooms.

Also on the slate is the feature documentary “Fear and Loathing in Kathmandu,” which Sharda is producing with Emmy-nominated Australian filmmaker Gil Marsden (“The Gymkhana Files,” “Revealed – Death Cap Murders”). The film is directed by Sparsh Ahuja, a National Geographic Explorer whose VR docu-drama “Child of Empire” premiered at Sundance in 2022. It charts Nepal’s journey from 1960s hippie haven, when cannabis was legal, through a U.S.-backed drug crackdown and decades of upheaval, and links it to today’s U.S. cannabis boom. Bodhini is also developing a comedy series about the Australian-Indian diaspora in Melbourne. Its title is under wraps while the project sits with a commissioner.

A Perth native who grew up in Melbourne, Sharda learned Hindi and Bharatanatyam in Australia before relocating to Mumbai, where she became a trailblazing Indian-Australian lead in mainstream Bollywood films. Her credits include “Besharam,” opposite Ranbir Kapoor, Hollywood’s “Tom & Jerry” and Netflix’s “Wedding Season,” which she led. She also picked up a Logie nomination for her turn opposite Sam Neill in Australian drama “The Twelve.”

EXCLUSIVE: Veteran execs from the media, entertainment and brand sectors have teamed up to launch an all-purpose advisory coalition, we can reveal.

The Unlabelled Alliance comprises Ex-UTA and Fremantle branded chief Sam Glynne, 7Wonder founder and TV producer Liza Abbott, Somethin’ Else director and audio indistry veteran Steve Ackerman, Gleam Futures founder and creator economy talent manager Dom Smales and Little Dot Studios co-founder Selma Turajlic.

Each has more than 20 years’ experience in their field, and they will look to bring their particular expertise to the advisory, which will look at helping media companies transform, innovate and scale by unlocking the value of their IP and forming partnerships with other players in digital, audio, talent and the brand space.

This will include monetizing content; repurposing catalog, licenses and distribution models; digital strategy; how to turn brands into partners, not simply sponsors; working with creators and talent; and backing the right digital-first ideas.

Each member of the Unlabelled Alliance will continue to run their own businesses and ventures, and provide tailored advice and support to clients – meaning they can form different combinations and find solutions based on the company.

The coalition is targeting broadcasters, studios, distributors, publishers, music companies, talent agencies, production companies and brands, and is pitching its offer as “experience-based solutions without the burden of fixed overheads.” As such they’re presenting the advisory as a “deliberately lean, plug-in model” that engages only as long as a problem requires.

Their rationale for the alliance is that the industry is not simply changing, but “fracturing and rebuilding itself in a completely different shape.” They note that broadcaster commission budgets are shrinking in many cases, while the creator economy is growing and formats often shift across mediums and platforms. The plan for the business has been in the works for some time, with a website now up and running, and we understand several deals are set to conclude.

“We came together as a group, first as friends and then with a shared vision of using our experience to future-proof the industry that we’ve grown up in,” the Unlabelled Alliance co-founders said in a statement.

“We built our careers in traditional media and went on to revolutionise it from the inside out: building and scaling businesses, pioneering digital-first content, creating new models for talent and re-imagining legacy IP potential. We know the pain points because we’ve been there. Our aim is your innovation and growth.”

They added they would be a “hands-on and results-driven advisory team of seasoned specialists, helping C-suites, boards, founders and investors work out what is stopping them scaling and delivering real, smart and swift solutions.”

Season 1 of 'Elite Force' spent four weeks in Netflix’s global Top 10 for non-English-language shows.

Netflix has kicked off production on the second season of “Elite Force,” its hit French action thriller starring Tomer Sisley (“Largo Winch”).

Created by Julien Leclercq and Sylvain Caron and directed by Leclercq, the series spent four weeks in Netflix’s global Top 10 for non-English-language shows and cracked the streamer’s Top 10 in 91 countries.

The second season will see David and Max, after being dismissed from the GIGN – France’s elite counterterrorism and hostage rescue unit — find themselves at the center of an incident that raises suspicions within their unit and threatens its very existence.

“We’re starting filming on Season 2 of ‘Elite Force’ today. Audiences followed us throughout the first season, and it’s with great excitement that we’re embarking on a new storyline with everything dialed up: intrigue, emotion, action… Everything is in place to deliver!” said Leclercq.

Netflix has a track record with French action thrillers, notably “Under Paris,” directed by Xavier Gens, and “AKA,” starring Alban Lenoir and Eric Cantona.

“Elite Force” marks a return to familiar territory for Leclercq, who previously chronicled one of the GIGN’s most high-profile operations in his 2011 film “The Assault,” based on the 1994 hijacking of an Air France plane. He has since become a regular collaborator of Netflix, directing “The Wages of Fear,” a remake of Henri-Georges Clouzot’s 1953 classic, and co-creating “Ganglands,” a crime series inspired by his 2015 heist thriller “Braqueurs.” The latter ran for two seasons on the streamer.

Sisley, meanwhile, is best known for starring in the franchise “Largo Winch,” adapted from the Belgian comic book series, as well as the French crime procedural “Balthazar” which ran for five seasons on TF1.

An audiovisual co-production treaty between India and Chile has reached the last stage of negotiation, according to Jorge Loyola Castro, Chile’s trade commissioner to India, who spoke to Variety at the International Film Festival of India in Goa.

The talks trace back to then-President Gabriel Boric’s state visit to India in April 2025, the first by a Chilean president since Michelle Bachelet’s trip in 2009. Castro says the visit set the co-production negotiations in motion. In a joint statement issued during the trip, Boric and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi named audiovisual co-production among the areas where the two countries would look to work together. José Antonio Kast succeeded Boric as president in March.

“It has been started and now is at the final, final stage, so we hope that we can bring some news soon,” Loyola tells Variety.

There is no firm date yet. Loyola points out that the process only began last year, adding: “We really, really hope that by next year we can announce something. If something happens earlier, more than happy, but it’s a priority for Chile as well.”

The treaty is moving alongside a broader trade pact, the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. The two sides finalized its terms of reference during Boric’s visit and have held four rounds of talks since, the most recent in New Delhi in December 2025, according to India’s embassy in Santiago. India’s commerce secretary traveled to Chile in August to advance the negotiations. Bilateral trade grew from $3.84 billion in 2024 to $5.38 billion in 2025, with Indian imports of Chilean gold accounting for much of the rise.

Chilean producers are already lining up. Giancarlo Nasi, producer and CEO of Quijote Films, which operates out of Santiago and Los Angeles, came off a strong 2025. Quijote produced Diego Céspedes’ “The Mysterious Gaze of the Flamingo,” winner of the Un Certain Regard prize at Cannes, and co-produced Gabriel Mascaro’s Brazilian drama “The Blue Trail,” which took the Grand Jury Prize in Berlin.

“I love pushing the boundaries of what is possible and doing the craziest co-production that you can find. So co-producing with India would be ideal,” Nasi says.

Without a treaty, Quijote gets around the gap by bringing in a partner from a third country that has a treaty with Chile. A French company on Ukrainian drama “Pamfir,” which played Cannes in 2022, allowed Quijote to tap the Chilean-French treaty. A French company was also attached early on to John Trengove’s South African drama “The Smell of Apples,” which premiered at Toronto in September, and a French producer is on board the documentary Quijote is now making with Moroccan filmmaker Asmae El Moudir, who shared Cannes’ documentary prize for “The Mother of All Lies” in 2023.

A direct treaty would remove that detour. Nasi says the key is for Chile to build “a minoritarian co-production fund that is bigger and bigger and stronger so it can actually make a difference for an Indian production.”

items.content:
中新网深圳11月24日电 以“阅读山海”为主题，将文学分享、扬琴演奏与公众共读置于山海之间——由深圳市盐田区委宣传部与“为你读诗”共同推出的“阅读山海”海边读书会，日前在深圳盐田海景公园观海平台举行。

作为“吾城吾诗——2026年深圳诗歌周”的系列活动之一，读书会依托深圳的山海资源与深厚的全民阅读氛围，以诗歌阅读为媒介，涵盖《山海集》线上系列节目、《阅读山海》海边读书会、《山海漫步》人文短片等多元内容，打通线上线下文化场景，力求进一步拓展全民阅读的公共空间，让湾区诗意与城市日常相连。现场参与者围绕“自己的山海”展开分享，也谈及“在场的山海”与“不在场的山海”。活动把“读书”的内涵从书本延伸向自然与日常生活，让阅读回到可感可亲的生活场景，阅读不仅在纸页之间发生，也是一次与自然、与城市、也与自己对话的过程。

当日活动尾声，全场齐声诵读《观沧海》，以铿锵共鸣，回应“怎样对海说话”这一诗意之问。

“天地有山海，阅读有山海，生命亦有山海。”这场海边读书会，以一曲琴音启幕，以众人共读收尾，被认为为第二十七届深圳读书月盐田区分会场，写下一页裹挟海风、书香的注脚。(完)

items.title: 【文化消费】英雄诗守千年根脉 木偶戏纳远方来韵
items.summary: 中新社北京11月24日电 题：英雄诗守千年根脉 木偶戏纳远方来韵
items.content:
“眺望远方，眼前是连绵的帕米尔群山。围坐毡房，耳边《玛纳斯》代代传唱。”生于新疆克孜勒苏柯尔克孜自治州(以下简称“克州”)阿合奇县的中国社会科学院民族文学研究所研究员阿地里·居玛吐尔地介绍，作为中国三大英雄史诗之一，《玛纳斯》在当地流传已有千年。

县内托什干河谷，散落着“穆兹布尔恰克之墓”“色尔哈克之墓”等诸多保存完好的史诗遗迹，常有民众以白马祭祀，祈求英灵守护。婚丧嫁娶时邀请玛纳斯奇(即《玛纳斯》演唱者)登门吟唱，亦是沿袭已久的古老传统。

“年少时，曾欣赏知名玛纳斯奇居素普·玛玛依演唱。”阿地里告诉记者，《玛纳斯》2006年、2009年先后入选中国首批国家级非物质文化遗产名录、联合国教科文组织人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。多年来，他观察到，史诗的保护传承持续推进，不仅新一代玛纳斯奇风格应时而变、各具韵味，史诗传播边界也在不断拓展，以多元形式延续生机。

青海湖诗歌广场上，《玛纳斯》雕塑与其他中外经典史诗的雕塑并肩而立；黑龙江富裕牧场柯尔克孜民俗景区内，二百余米长的史诗文化长廊吸引各地游客驻足；2007年起在克州举办的玛纳斯国际文化旅游节愈办愈盛……

“《玛纳斯》就像一棵大树，四季流转、样貌有变，但树始终是这棵树。”在阿地里看来，演绎形式与时俱进，但其中蕴含的世界观、人生观，以及所歌颂的民族团结精神和家国情怀，始终植根于故土。

新疆大学副教授聂楠关注到另一道文化风景——克拉玛依木偶戏。这门艺术于20世纪80年代随人口流动落脚油城。

“创始人姚连成自小研习秦腔，将戏曲功底融入木偶戏创作。”聂楠介绍，克拉玛依木偶戏以秦腔为主唱腔，搭配影子腔、地方小曲，对白兼顾陕西方言与奇台方言，曲调高亢激越。

“剧团赴各地公益演出，场场爆满。改编剧目《阿凡提》尤为亮眼。”她回忆，木偶身着民族特色服饰，演绎新疆本土故事，收获广泛好评。

追溯故乡文脉，融合地方风情，克拉玛依木偶戏慢慢形成独属油城的风格；2012年，由克拉玛依市申报的木偶戏列入第三批自治区级非物质文化遗产名录。

阿地里认为，这体现新疆文化沃土海纳百川，传统得到保护、发展，新事物得到接纳、生长。

items.content:
光荣特库摩宣布，好评发售中的黑暗战国动作RPG《仁王3》DLC第 二弹“天草大乱”将于2026年12月17日（四）正式推出，并公开预告视频。同时，也宣布将发售收录游戏本篇与两部付费DLC的《仁王3》完全版。

本DLC中，全新场景“岛原”正式登场。DLC第一弹“庆安地狱变”故事中的阴谋，将在此迎来完结。不仅描写竹千代与天草四郎率领的一揆众之间的战斗，立花宗茂等与系列过往作品相关的人物也将登场。除了大量添加妖怪、守护灵以及武技、技能、忍术、阴阳术之外，还将实装全新的终局内容“修罗战场”。另外，只要同时拥有DLC第一弹与第二弹，就能开放高难度模式“仁王的旅途（第四轮）”，加上装备的最高稀有度“神宝”。本DLC将带来丰富且值得深入钻研的要素，让玩家体验“仁王”系列特有的成就感。敬请期待这段横跨两部DLC的阴谋故事迎来最终篇章。

在追查西班牙炼金术师下落的过程中，竹千代得知由井正雪的遗恨源于昔日的岛原，于是在白鸦的引导下，再度穿越时空。

在1638年的岛原，一揆势力、炼金术师与妖怪联手，与幕府军展开血腥厮杀，令此地化为激战之地。

为了揭穿阴谋，竹千代将与率领一揆势力的天草四郎、历经乱世的传奇名将立花宗茂，以及对抗炼金术师的武士等新登场人物相遇，一步步踏入岛原的深渊。

敬请亲眼见证阴谋的真相，以及竹千代跨越时空、贯串自太古以来各个时代的故事，最终将走向何方。

本DLC的舞台为1638年的“岛原”。从一揆众与幕府军激烈交锋的战场，延伸到云仙岳内部的洞窟，以及一揆众的大本营原城，各具特色的场景正等待着竹千代的到来。敬请体验这场令人手心冒汗的紧张激战，为故事画下精彩句点。

本DLC中，率领一揆众的天草四郎、身经百战的传奇名将立花宗茂，以及对抗炼金术师的武士将会登场。除了“庆安地狱变”中的人物将再度于故事中露脸，还将有全新妖怪挡在竹千代面前。而为竹千代带来全新力量的守护灵之中，也有令人怀念的身影。敬请期待充满“仁王”系列特色的黑暗战国故事，以及与众多强敌之间的死斗。

本DLC将为所有武器种类添加武技，并加入大量变化武技、忍术、阴阳术及使役符。另外，只要同时拥有DLC第一弹与第二弹，并通关“顿悟的旅途（第三轮）”后，将会开放添加难度“仁王的旅途（第四轮）”。“仁王的旅途（第四轮）”中，将会掉落最高稀有度的“神宝”装备，让玩家在深入钻研玩法、探索自由配装的各种可能时追求极致。

items.content:
独家报道：对于讽刺播客《Fin Vs History》的一半成员 Fin Taylor 来说，现在已经不能再回到电视了。

这位英国单口喜剧演员、作家和播客主持人与喜剧演员霍雷肖·古尔德一起主持自己的节目，多年来曾出现在《阿波罗号现场》和《最后一站》等英国主要喜剧节目中，但他故意令人震惊的风格对他来说并不合适。

当我们在伦敦汉姆庭院酒店坐下来吃午餐时，他回忆起为 BBC 新闻讽刺剧《马什报道》制作的 VT，该视频被严重删减，使得他刻意反觉醒的角色看起来比讽刺新闻记者更“法西斯”。他很生气。

“那是在新冠疫情期间，特工们不被允许出庭记录，”他回忆道。 “我走进画廊，把我的玩具从婴儿车里扔了出来，然后说，‘你不能在展览中使用它。’我基本上接受了我不会被要求回复，但奇怪的是，他们第二天早上打电话道歉，并让我为他们写更多的东西。”

items.originalContent:
EXCLUSIVE: For Fin Taylor, one half of the satirical podcast Fin Vs History, there’s no going back to TV now.

The British stand-up comedian, writer and podcaster, who fronts his show with fellow comedian Horatio Gould, had over the years made appearances on staple British comedy shows such as Live at the Apollo and The Last Leg, but his deliberately shocking style didn’t feel like a good fit – to him.

As we sit down for lunch at the Ham Yard Hotel in London, he recalls making a VT for BBC news satire The Mash Report that had been cut so severely that it made his deliberately anti-woke character seemed more “fascist” than a satirical take on a news reporter. He was livid.

“This was during Covid, when agents weren’t allowed to come to the record,” he recalls. “I went into the gallery and I threw my toys out of the pram, and said, ‘You can’t use that in the show.’ I had basically accepted I wouldn’t be asked back, but weirdly they called the next morning and apologized, and they got me to write more stuff for them.”

Even though that worked out, the incident was one of several that made Taylor seek out a different path. There was also a wild broadcast where he was asked to give the British perspective on NFL Network’s Good Morning Football, leading to what can only be described as mayhem and the naming of his company, Fumblerooski Productions. Watch the video below for context on that.

Taylor knew that his television future would be “the funny guy on a show that’s not comedy, like Sewing Bee,” but says: “They’re never going to book me to do that because I’m a bull in a China shop. They’re not putting me on The Great British Bake Off. I needed to do my own thing.”

For Gould, a comedian’s life as a TV star felt even more alien. “I didn’t see anything on TV that I would want to do, or would want me,” he says. Both men had been active on the UK stand-up scene, but Gould, who’s slightly younger than his podcast partner, natively posted his comedy online, and he was sure his future was more likely in digital self-publishing than on the BBC or ITV.

“We all looked over to America, which is always five years ahead,” says Gould. “There were so many comedians doing video podcasts and shows it was only a matter of time before it came over here.”

Soon Taylor, Gould and Irish comedian Vittorio Angelone had devised Fin Vs the Internet, an online comedy series vehicle for Taylor in which he would play a deluded interviewer determined to find out why those he spoke with had bigger and better online followings than he did.

“He was like a Between Two Ferns-meets-Eric Andre character, who has no idea how the internet works and has views of a man from the ’50s,” says Gould, who wrote and produced the show, but remained off screen. “These were people who are very careful about their brands and he was like a bulldozer,” adds Taylor.

items.content:
除了首页时间流和侧栏的精选展位，少数派 Matrix 社区还有很多优秀内容因条件所限无法得到有效曝光，因此我们决定重启 Matrix 周报，并在此基础上添加更多社区内容、作者投稿新玩意呈现给大家。

上周社区速递：社区速递 166｜柯尼卡胶片机、iPhone Duo 体验与假期省钱实操大赏

为了让作者的投稿尽快与广大读者见面，我们调整了《新玩意》栏目中作者投稿部分的呈现方式和周期，作者投稿的「新玩意」后续会迁移至本栏目。投稿渠道与奖励方式仍与以往完全一致，详情参见文末。我们相信新鲜火热出炉的分享更能赢得大家的喜爱，也欢迎广大读者朋友们踊跃投稿。

搬家之后，通勤距离从原来的 15 km 缩短到了 3 km，开车变成了一个性价比极低且经常「还不如走路快」的通勤方式。在忍受了一年多共享单车开锁即坏、车把歪斜、甚至要求我在马路中央还车等一系列荒谬问题后，我决定买一辆自己的短途代步工具。考虑到终点附近充电不便，以前还有过自行车被偷的经历，所以我把目光看向了可以带上楼的折叠自行车。

选购折叠自行车，轻量便携和折叠机构的稳固可靠是两个刚性条件。其次就是购买渠道，对于我这种自行车小白来说，能够先行试车、便于维保售后的线下渠道更合适。在符合要求的品牌中，大行最主流，改装生态也好，只是价格不太美丽；喜德盛等品牌虽物美价廉，但网点位置不多且都是经销商模式。而迪卡侬作为专业领域的连锁品牌，在产品质量有保障的基础上，其服务标准也相对统一，对于普通用户来说更加友好。碰巧在某次比价过程中，我在迪卡侬小程序上刷到附近门店有一辆 A 级成色的 Fold 560，价格与个人二手卖家相差无几，却能享受门店的保养服务以及与新车相同的官方质保政策，于是我当天就前往门店，查看实车后入手。

Fold 560 在迪卡侬折叠车产品线里属于顶配车型了，车架和前叉均为铝合金材质，12 kg 的重量实际感受并不算轻，不过拎着上两级台阶没什么压力；座管长度非常充裕，我 185 cm 的身高调整到合适位置后仍有升高的余量；变速器则采用了禧玛诺的 Sora 九速变速器，虽然实际用不上这么多档位，但 9 个飞轮意味着更大的变速范围，所能应付的坡道场景也更多。

其他车辆本身的参数配置在这里就不赘述了，我更想分享的是 Fold 560 的折叠体验和一些使用细节，因为这辆车虽然看起来似乎很「粗犷」，可真到手上用起来，发现它处处都显露着「实用主义」。

首先是折叠体验上，Fold 560 的折叠锁扣足够宽大且带有着力点，头管解锁按键也正好对应大拇指的位置，解锁或锁紧操作都能单手完成。折叠之后，两个轮子会以平行姿态通过磁吸扣吸附在一起，只要位置准确，磁吸扣的力度大到展开时往往需要扭转车把才能让前轮脱离。

座垫下方单独设计了一个推行把手，推行状态下，我并不需要全手发力抬起车身，只需将推行把手挂在手掌上即可轻松前进。更省心的是，Fold 560 车架下方自带一个金属支撑架，车辆以折叠姿态停放时，我可以自然地将车身放到地面，不需要像其他两折叠车辆那样必须把座管插到底才能勉强立住。

另一个非常打动我的细节是 Fold 560 自带变速器保护架。这个保护架能够在变速器外侧形成一个支撑空间，避免变速器尾勾被磕碰挤压导致变形。虽然这不是什么专利技术，电商平台也有售卖成品，但出厂标配就这样一个配件，说明车辆已经做好了「开箱即用」的准备，尤其是对于很多有「4+2」需求而购买折叠车的人来说，哪怕提车当天放到后备箱、载去郊外骑行踏春，也不用担心后备箱杂物挤压了变速器。

items.content:
中新网芜湖11月24日电 (刘鸿鹤)“2025年度的发掘有一个重要收获，就是我们发现了青白瓷原料加工的一个完整作坊，以及作坊产生的尾砂堆积。”安徽省文物考古研究所副研究馆员罗虎24日接受采访时说，这是繁昌窑历次考古中首次识别出这类尾砂堆积，为认识古代制瓷原料加工技术提供了新的实物资料。

据罗虎介绍，此次发掘由安徽省文物考古研究所主持，作坊及尾砂堆积位于繁昌窑遗址发掘的10号和11号探方内。尾砂是瓷石等原料经粉碎、淘洗、分选后留下的废弃物料，其堆积形态与分布范围，可在一定程度上反映原料加工场地的位置与规模。由于遗迹保存状况较好，考古人员得以较完整地观察原料加工环节的遗存分布。

繁昌窑位于安徽省芜湖市繁昌区，创烧于五代、兴盛于北宋，是我国最早烧制青白瓷的古窑址之一。此前研究认为，繁昌窑将窑址附近出产的岩石状原料与高岭土混合制胎，形成“二元配方”工艺，比景德镇同类技术早300余年。“这个发现及后续检测分析，应该能够深化我们对‘二元配方’技术的研究。”罗虎说。

“另外就是繁昌窑的产品有没有参与到海上丝绸之路的贸易，这也是学界一个关注的重点。”罗虎说，有专家在学术报告中认为，繁昌窑青白瓷曾参与海上丝绸之路贸易，销往今东南亚一带；从产品形制及工艺特征看，东南亚地区已发现的相关产品疑似为繁昌窑产品。

他透露，北京大学相关团队正在东南亚开展考古和贸易陶瓷研究，初步来看，相关产品可能与繁昌窑关系密切，“这是我们以后关注的一个研究方向”。

据了解，繁昌窑遗址2022年成为第四批国家考古遗址公园立项项目，今年“五一”假期正式向公众开放，园内龙窑保护大棚、龙窑遗迹展示馆、作坊区及窑包复原展示区已陆续开放，繁昌窑遗址博物馆正在建设中。

罗虎说，繁昌窑遗址考古工作重心已从最初的考古发掘与研究，逐步转化为配合遗址公园建设，开展资料整理和研究，揭示和阐释繁昌窑遗址文物价值为主，让更多观众能近距离感受青白瓷文化。(完)

items.summary: 中新网香港11月24日电 (记者 张语洽)“浩大的海风吹着我们，穿过夜的疾寒与烂漫。”香港湾仔海滨一个明信片造型的镂空装置上，印有香港作家萍儿《那深深的海》中的诗句。透过装置，维多利亚港及对岸尖沙咀的城市景观映入眼帘，文学与现实交织成一幅生动的香港海景图。
items.content:
中新网香港11月24日电 (记者 张语洽)“浩大的海风吹着我们，穿过夜的疾寒与烂漫。”香港湾仔海滨一个明信片造型的镂空装置上，印有香港作家萍儿《那深深的海》中的诗句。透过装置，维多利亚港及对岸尖沙咀的城市景观映入眼帘，文学与现实交织成一幅生动的香港海景图。

香港文学馆24日举办香港海洋文学散步媒体导赏团，该活动是“字造海洋——首届香港海洋文学节”系列活动之一，团队沿海滨路线走访城市地标，透过描绘香港海洋的文学作品，重新认识香港海岸线的历史变迁及港口城市的发展脉络。

香港海洋文学散步以叶灵凤、舒巷城等9位作家的作品为线索，策划“海湾之历史变迁”及“港口的城市映像”两条主题路线。通过沿途经典文本与现实地景的对照，参与者可重新认识香港海岸线的变化，了解从早期商埠、水上族群生活、填海拓地到当代都市的历史变迁，探索香港海洋文学所承载的城市记忆。

此次文学节主题展览分为香港文学馆及湾仔海滨公园两个展区，设有“岛、渡、湾、港、鱼”五个章节。湾仔海滨沿途设有多个互动装置，包括鱼缸、海岛等5种造型的小型设施以及3个大型打卡装置。装置设计融入文学文本细节以及海洋元素，市民游客可透过镂空景框欣赏维港景色，阅读作家笔下的海洋文学字句，或扫码收听导览介绍及制作电子明信片。

香港文学馆市场部经理洪巧静表示，希望通过此次活动将文学从馆内展览延伸至城市街道和海滨空间，让市民游客在日常漫步中感受文学与城市的联系，丰富香港文化旅游体验。

据悉，“港口的城市映像”导赏团将于2026年11月至2027年1月期间逢周末举行，公众可免费报名参加。文学节还将推出文学展览、文学沙龙及海洋文学嘉年华等系列活动。(完)

items.content:
中新社广州11月24日电 (记者 张璐)“中国duanju现在特别‘走红’，我和身边许多留学生同学，都喜欢追中国的微短剧。”正在中山大学读博士的巴基斯坦留学生喜娜(Heena Rathore)近日对中新社记者说。

当下，汉语拼音“duanju”在海外出圈，成为中国微短剧的专属代称。喜娜表示，她喜欢AI制作的动漫类微短剧，平时常追乡村故事、家庭言情类作品，并推荐给巴基斯坦的亲友。“无论是悬疑类还是喜剧类作品，内容都很精彩、很吸引人，也是了解中国传统文化的一个好窗口。”

中国国家广播电视总局统计数据显示，2026年前8个月，中国上线微短剧43万部，是2025年全年的13倍。中国国家广播电视总局发展研究中心等单位联合发布的《AI驱动全球微短剧创新发展报告》显示，2025年，全球微短剧市场进入爆发增长期，全球市场规模接近180亿美元，中国市场规模突破140亿美元，占全球市场的77.78%。

广东现拥有超1.8万家微短剧相关企业，依托深厚的产业基础与对外传播优势，正加速构建微短剧“出海高地”。

“目前，公司正重点布局AI漫剧生产与文化出海，希望把更多中国微短剧故事带给海外观众。”广州快玩微剧文化科技有限公司商务部总监林维冰介绍，该公司2025年推出的《遥相思》《慕黎色》等真人微短剧，全网播放量均突破10亿次。“我们给TikTok平台的授权覆盖全球范围，目前海外剧主要面向欧美地区受众。”林维冰说。

光影漫纪(广州)文化科技有限公司正在制作一部岭南江岛与奇幻镜境交织、星座元素穿越时空的爱情微短剧《黄埔十二愿》，海外发行重点覆盖马来西亚、泰国等国家。总经理冀仕杰介绍，该公司正把AI落地到拍摄、后期制作的具体环节，降低创作门槛，助力微短剧顺利出海。

今年以来，广东多地密集出台微短剧产业扶持政策，深圳、广州、佛山等地分别从本土内容创作、AI赋能出海等方面推出专项扶持措施。目前，广东微短剧产业已形成中国领先的全链条集群规模。

中新网马尼拉11月24日电 2026中国电影节23日晚在菲律宾北伊罗戈省首府拉瓦格市开幕。中国驻拉瓦格领事馆馆长领事李小艳、北伊罗戈省省长塞西莉亚出席开幕式并致辞。中国驻菲律宾大使馆文化参赞黄雅萍、北伊罗戈省班纳市市长、拉瓦格市副市长等百余人出席活动。

李小艳表示，这是中国电影节首次走进菲律宾北吕宋地区，希望通过一方银幕让更多菲律宾朋友近距离读懂中国。中国驻拉瓦格领事馆愿携手领区各界，以光景搭建友谊之桥，激活两国地方间文化交流活力，丰富友好互动内涵。

塞西莉亚感谢领事馆长期以来为促进菲中友好交流所作的努力。她表示，中国电影节有助于增进菲律宾民众对中国的了解，深化两国人民的感情与互信，期待未来双方开展更多文化交流活动。

开幕式后，与会嘉宾共同观看了开幕影片《八仙》。本届电影节将持续至11月29日，期间还将展映《毕正明的证明》《拼桌》《年会不能停2》《好东西》等多部中国影片，为菲律宾观众呈现中国电影的多元风貌。(完)

EXCLUSIVE: An upcoming three-part true crime series out of the UK and New Zealand will investigate the 2002 disappearance of mother and model Alysha Hanin.

Sky New Zealand has greenlit I Will Find You: The Search For Alysha Hanin from local producer Our Story and the UK-based Woodcut International, which has picked up international distribution rights.

Production is currently ongoing ahead of a scheduled Q2 2027 launch, with New Zealand On Air supporting.

The story will look into at the case of 24-year-old Alysha Hanin, who walked out of Miami Beach’s Shore Club hotel and vanished 24 years ago. Her luggage, ID and bank cards remained behind, but there was no confirmed sightings, no body and no answer.

Her three-year-old son Adrian grew up in New Zealand with this mystery at the centre of his life, and now aged 27, he stops waiting and starts investigating.

The I Will Find You doc team follows Adrian from New Zealand to the U.S., as he rebuilds his mother’s case from the ground up – opening long-preserved files, finding witnesses, testing old accounts, reconstructing timelines and assembling a substantial investigative dossier. Then, while the cameras are following him in Miami, the Miami Beach Police begin actively reinvestigating Alysha’s disappearance as a homicide.

Jane Robertson and Jeremy Hall, co-founders at Our Story said in a statement: “Most true-crime documentaries arrive after the critical events have happened. We were there before anyone knew what was going to happen.

“We filmed Adrian finding witnesses, uncovering evidence and rebuilding his mother’s case from the ground up — and then watched a 24-year-old missing-person case become an active homicide investigation. You can’t manufacture that kind of actuality. The cameras were already rolling when the story changed.”

Koulla Anastasi, Managing Director at Woodcut International, added: “This is not only a fascinating series but an incredibly unique documentary as the story is still unfolding. To not have closure on the disappearance of a loved one will touch many viewers worldwide. We are confident our buyers will want to be part of this journey, and see Adrian eventually solve this mystery and find some form of resolution.”

items.summary: AI创作绝不允许盗脸、偷声、魔改(坚持“两创”·关注新大众文艺)
items.content:
如果AI侵权套利成为常态，粗暴掠夺创作权益，无偿窃取劳动成果，肆意消解文化记忆，势必挫伤创作热情和行业信心，最终殃及文化创新的源头活水

近日，AI(人工智能)内容创作侵权再度引发广泛关注和批评。一部“黛玉重生”AI短剧，一次性盗用了87版电视剧《红楼梦》中17名演员的“脸”，演员们30多年前独创性表演中的神情与气韵，被毫不客气地拿来就用。不仅如此，该剧还用爽剧复仇套路篡改经典，“林黛玉当街掌嘴薛宝钗”“贾母跪拜黛玉”等雷人情节，让观众直呼：“看不下去”“不是创作，是抢劫”。

从“盗脸”挪用形象、“偷声”克隆语音，再到“魔改”解构经典，一些制作者借助AI，将“盗、偷、改”视作低成本涨粉变现的捷径，一再挑战法律红线和价值底线，为社会大众所诟病。今年以来，有10余名演员就此公开发声，诉诸法律。

演员的脸，不是AI的开源素材。凝结在文艺作品中的闪光的才情，也不该被AI拿来即用。目前的AI视频制作工具，对直接上传真人照片作为角色参考，大都做了风险提示或技术限制，但很多制作方选择视而不见。技术限制也只需稍加学习，通过外部“炼脸”、旁路导入等方法就能绕过。侵权行为隐蔽、复制速度快，叠加AI内容海量上新、迭代迅速的行业特征，侵权者“打一枪换一个地方”，不仅误导大众审美，破坏行业生态，而且引发诈骗等社会问题，给治理带来严峻挑战。

治理AI创作侵权，不能只靠个案曝光、事后下架，而是需要多方同频发力、集中应对。

以AI魔改为例。相比盗脸、偷声，魔改视频明显数量更多，影响更大。AI魔改不仅关乎特定作品和创作者的权益，更关乎文化认知和文化主体性。一些针对四大名著、革命题材和英模人物题材等经典内容的恶俗改编，混淆了观众特别是未成年观众的文化认知，带来价值观错位。

整治AI魔改，既需要创作者树立文化自觉，守住敬畏之心，审慎面对历史与经典，也需要一套技术防控、平台把关、法治兜底的组合拳。如，在模型与工具端设置技术闸门，完善训练数据溯源管理，落实AI生成内容强制标识，从严从细强化内容审核，动态建立违规账号黑名单等。

早在2023年，《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》就提出了发展和安全并重、促进创新和依法治理相结合的原则，并就尊重知识产权、不得侵害他人肖像权等作出明确规定。广电总局今年年初开展了AI魔改视频专项治理，正在开展的微短剧专项治理也将AI盗脸、偷声作为整治重点。

在具体的司法实践中，可识别即认定侵权，制作方故意为之、平台未尽审查均需担责，由开发者对模型训练数据来源举证等原则也在逐步确立。今年9月，最高人民法院发布的《关于依法审理涉人工智能纠纷案件的意见》，针对AI侵害人格权益、知识产权这类纠纷的裁判思路、责任划分进一步给出司法依据。

平台是行业的枢纽，也是直接面向海量创作者的把关人，必须增强责任意识，在打击AI侵权上发挥应有作用。不能一边盘算着流量账，一边以内容海量、认定困难为由消极推诿，或简单用“已下线拦截了多少”作敷衍。头部平台更应跳出流量思维，完善算法和审核机制，将文化价值与社会责任纳入推荐逻辑，从源头处压住盗脸、偷声、魔改的生存空间。

items.summary: Pearl Abyss 旗下《红色沙漠：增强版》在英国伦敦举办的“英国游戏开发者协会大奖 2026（TIGA Games Industry Awards 2026，以下简称TIGA）”中，荣获“最佳动作冒险游戏”奖。 TIGA是由英国游戏开发者及行业专家组成评审团的游戏行业奖项，旨在表彰游戏开发及整个游戏产业领域的优秀成果，并评选出表现出色的游戏作品与企业。 “最佳动作冒险游戏奖”主要综合评审游戏在创意与创新玩法、视觉及音效设计，以及整体游戏设计完成度等方面的表现。
items.content:
Pearl Abyss 旗下《红色沙漠：增强版》在英国伦敦举办的“英国游戏开发者协会大奖 2026（TIGA Games Industry Awards 2026，以下简称TIGA）”中，荣获“最佳动作冒险游戏”奖。

TIGA是由英国游戏开发者及行业专家组成评审团的游戏行业奖项，旨在表彰游戏开发及整个游戏产业领域的优秀成果，并评选出表现出色的游戏作品与企业。

“最佳动作冒险游戏奖”主要综合评审游戏在创意与创新玩法、视觉及音效设计，以及整体游戏设计完成度等方面的表现。《红色沙漠：增强版》凭借独具特色的动作体验、开放世界设计，以及基于自研引擎实现的出色技术表现，获得评审团的高度认可。

通过在多个全球性游戏奖项中获得认可，《红色沙漠：增强版》进一步展现了其在游戏品质与技术实力方面的竞争力，以及作为全球化游戏IP的发展潜力。

此前，《红色沙漠：增强版》还曾荣获2026金摇杆奖的“年度最佳 PC 游戏”，以及由英国游戏开发者大会主办的Develop:Star Awards中的“最佳技术创新奖”。

items.summary: 兰比尔·卡普尔主演的奇幻史诗片《梵天：第一部——湿婆》的导演阿扬·穆克吉 (Ayan Mukerji) 在果阿举行的第 57 届印度国际电影节 (IFFI) 上告诉观众，他的下一个创作重点是续集《梵天 2》。（来源：Variety·全球流媒体与影视商业）
items.content:
兰比尔·卡普尔主演的奇幻史诗片《梵天：第一部——湿婆》的导演阿扬·穆克吉 (Ayan Mukerji) 在果阿举行的第 57 届印度国际电影节 (IFFI) 上告诉观众，他的下一个创作重点是续集《梵天 2》。

Ayan Mukerji, director of the Ranbir Kapoor-starring fantasy epic “Brahmastra: Part One – Shiva,” told audiences at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa that his next creative focus is the sequel, “Brahmastra 2.”

“I hope that we can make ‘Brahmastra 2’ even more Indian,” Mukerji said, adding that he hoped to draw more deeply from Indian mythology this time.

Mukerji was in conversation with Basil Joseph, the director of Malayalam-language superhero film “Minnal Murali,” at a session titled “The Epic Genres – Mythologies, Superheroes & New Worlds,” where the two made the case for homegrown fantasy franchises.

“We have our own heroes which we call gods,” Joseph said when asked what makes Indian fantasy distinct. The West, he said, wrote its superheroes into comics, and he linked the genre’s pull to hope. “The storytelling has always been around,” said Mukerji, pointing to Indian television, adding that vast territory remains untouched on the big screen.

Mukerji credited advances in VFX with making such projects feel feasible. Joseph had little time for AI as a creative shortcut. “AI is not creating anything new; it’s reproducing,” he said, predicting that the future will be “all about originality.”

“I was discovering the kind of film I was trying to make,” Mukerji said of “Brahmastra,” the Hindi-language fantasy released in 2022 with Kapoor as Shiva. The film started life as “a slightly more intimate coming-of-age film” called “Dragon” before growing in budget, effects work and scope. “Some people liked the film, some people didn’t. But the audience is very smart and you have to respect their reaction even if it doesn’t go in your favor,” he said.

Looking back, Mukerji said that spending so much time with “Brahmastra” in post-production had led him to cut scenes and actors’ pauses too sharply for the theatrical release. He later restored some of them in the streaming version. “Overthinking is not always improving,” he said.

Joseph made “Minnal Murali,” set in the fictional village of Kurukkanmoola, within the budget of a Malayalam-language production. He pointed to the look of protagonist Jaison (Tovino Thomas), drawn from the rural Kerala milieu, and a scarecrow face standing in for a villain’s disguise. “All these ideas came from that restriction,” he said. Unable to lean on heavy VFX, his team chose to “get the basics right,” betting that a strong script would carry the film even where the effects fell short. “The restrictions made the film more innovative,” he said.

In hindsight, Joseph said, “I got a little carried away with the villain of that film.” He cautioned that filmmakers building new worlds “get too ambitious” and “overpack everything.” His advice was to “keep it simple, be original and don’t try too hard to look cool.”

“Minnal Murali” was made for theaters, Joseph said, but the pandemic and theater closures led to its release on Netflix. “Everything happens for a reason,” he said, adding that while a sequel was planned if the film worked, for now he was busy with a different project.
